slides.headline: Packaging supplier consolidation: is a single supplier worth it?
slides.why_not_merge: Framing slides (title, executive summary, next steps) carry no key-line point; each has a distinct job: open, answer up front, close with approvable asks

slides.purpose: Give the answer and the asks up front
slides.headline: Reject the 100% move to Supplier B and approve a 70/30 split: €1.79M a year, €4.88M net over 2026-2028, with a second plant kept
slides.reason_to_exist: Board members read the answer first
slides.why_not_merge: Framing slides (title, executive summary, next steps) carry no key-line point; each has a distinct job: open, answer up front, close with approvable asks

slides.purpose: Correct the saving the board is asked to approve
slides.headline: Procurement's €3.0M a year is really €2.87M: the 12% cut cannot apply to €1.1M of rush freight
slides.reason_to_exist: Shows the proposal's arithmetic does not hold before any risk is counted

slides.purpose: Quantify the single-plant risk against the extra saving
slides.headline: Supplier B's single plant stopped twice in three years; a repeat would cost €4.0M, more than the €2.93M the full move adds over a 70/30 split
slides.reason_to_exist: This is the trade-off that decides between full and partial consolidation

slides.headline: A 70/30 split nets €4.88M over 2026-2028, ahead of €3.80M for the full move once stoppage risk is counted
slides.reason_to_exist: Gives the board the approvable alternative with each option costed

slides.purpose: Show where the remaining gap to €3.0M can come from
slides.headline: The gap to €3.0M is ours to close: €0.65M of €1.1M rush freight falls in months flagged as our own forecast errors
slides.reason_to_exist: Answers 'what about the rest of the saving?' and assigns the lever to demand planning, not procurement

slides.purpose: Close with approvable asks, gates and KPIs
slides.headline: Today: reject the full move, approve the 70/30 split and €0.5M switching budget, commission the rush-freight review
slides.reason_to_exist: Turns the recommendation into decisions with owners, gates and KPIs
